A list of 113 land sites covering about 390 ha forms the land bank for the 2026 – 2030 period.

hồ sơ mua nhà ở xã hội nộp trực tiếp cho: social housing applications are submitted directly to the developer and assessed against the conditions; avoid offers to "hold a slot" or "buy back a slot" that involve payment.
